native_primary: (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id

wave_fields.name: c.title
wave_fields.updated_at: case when w.updated_at is null and c.updated_at=c.created_at then null else c.updated_at end
wave_fields.participation_signature_required: case nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.participation_config, '$.signature_required')), 'null') when 'true' then 1 when 'false' then 0 else cast(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.participation_config, '$.signature_required')), 'null') as signed) end
wave_fields.voting_signature_required: case nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.voting_config, '$.signature_required')), 'null') when 'true' then 1 when 'false' then 0 else cast(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.voting_config, '$.signature_required')), 'null') as signed) end
wave_fields.forbid_negative_votes: case nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.voting_config, '$.forbid_negative_votes')), 'null') when 'true' then 1 when 'false' then 0 else cast(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(c.voting_config, '$.forbid_negative_votes')), 'null') as signed) end

drop_type: case when e.status='WINNER' then 'WINNER' when e.status='ACTIVE' then 'PARTICIPATORY' when e.status in ('WITHDRAWN','DISQUALIFIED') then 'CHAT' when d.drop_type='COMPETITION' then 'CHAT' else d.drop_type end

drop_ranks.from: competition_entries e join competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id and (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id join competition_entry_runtime r on r.entry_id=e.id and r.competition_id=c.id where ((e.status='ACTIVE' and (r.last_increased_at is not null or r.real_time_rating<>0)) or (e.status='WINNER' and r.last_increased_at is not null))

drop_voter_states.from: competition_entries e join competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id and (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id join competition_votes v on v.entry_id=e.id and v.competition_id=c.id

wave_leaderboard_entries.from: competition_entries e join competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id and (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id join competition_leaderboard_entries lb on lb.entry_id=e.id and lb.competition_id=c.id left join competition_entry_runtime r on r.entry_id=e.id and r.competition_id=c.id where e.status='ACTIVE' and (exists(select 1 from wave_leaderboard_entries original where original.drop_id=e.drop_id and original.wave_id=c.wave_id) or (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(c.decision_config,'$.time_lock_ms')) as signed)>0 and lb.updated_at>e.submitted_at))
wave_leaderboard_entries.ownership: and exists(select 1 from competition_entries e where e.competition_id=c.id and e.drop_id=s.drop_id and e.status='ACTIVE')

wave_decisions.from: competitions c join competition_decisions d on d.competition_id=c.id where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id and d.status='COMPLETED'

wave_decision_winner_drops.from: competitions c join competition_decision_winners win on win.competition_id=c.id join competition_decisions d on d.competition_id=c.id and d.id=win.decision_id left join competition_entries e on e.id=win.entry_id and e.competition_id=c.id where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id and coalesce(win.legacy_drop_id,e.drop_id) is not null

fields.prizes: coalesce((select json_arrayagg(a.award) over(order by a.outcome_position,a.id rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following) from competition_outcome_awards a where a.competition_id=c.id and a.decision_id=d.id and a.entry_id=win.entry_id limit 1),json_array())

wave_outcomes.from: competitions c join competition_outcomes o on o.competition_id=c.id where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id

wave_outcome_distribution_items.from: competitions c join competition_outcomes o on o.competition_id=c.id join competition_outcome_distribution_items i on i.outcome_id=o.id and i.competition_id=c.id where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id
wave_outcome_distribution_items.ownership: and exists(select 1 from competition_outcomes o where o.competition_id=c.id and o.position=s.wave_outcome_position)

winner_drop_voter_votes.from: competition_entries e join competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id and (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id join competition_winner_votes v on v.entry_id=e.id and v.competition_id=c.id and v.decision_id=e.decision_id

waves_decision_pauses.from: competitions c join competition_pauses p on p.competition_id=c.id where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id and p.legacy_source_id is not null

wave_voting_credit_nfts.from: competitions c join json_table(c.voting_config,'$.credit_nfts[*]' columns(contract varchar(50) path '$.contract',token_id bigint path '$.token_id')) n where (c.storage_mode='NATIVE' or exists(select 1 from competition_legacy_mirror_permits p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.connection_id=connection_id() and p.depth=-1)) and c.legacy_wave_id=c.wave_id
